analysis:
Reviewed all three batch analyses and available source replay; replay omits 11 of 22 reviewed units, including the setup caller and tests needed to independently validate the candidate finding.

SandboxSetupProgress.swift's changed confirmation helper (head 459–464, patch coordinates) demonstrably converts EOF to an empty answer and accepts it when defaultYes is true. The reported slot-reduction caller at SandboxSetupCommand.swift:214–215 is not replayed. Therefore the claimed security impact remains unresolved rather than independently established; inspect that caller and reject nil input if it authorizes reductions.

SandboxSlotChange.swift:16–30 compares installed totals to planned counts, classifies nondecreasing counts as additive, and copies counts into setup options. Missing platform totals become zero; whether this can misclassify a reduction depends on the omitted status contract. SandboxEligibility.swift:225–226,308–309 adds planned disk consumption to informational shortfall arithmetic; verify plan bounds before multiplication/addition, not assume malformed values are accepted.

sandboxes.md:85–94,120–125 describes installed-Mac replanning, additive-only unattended changes, skipping active jobs and never forwarding --force. TB-013/T-061/A-019 cover installer execution as the owner; TB-012/T-059/A-018 cover serving exclusion and availability. Remaining material review: verify setup confirmation admission and installer arguments, and confirm the installer atomically refuses replacement when a job starts after the status snapshot. Documentation and mocked tests cannot prove or disprove that external fence.

No independently supported regression is established by the replay in encryption, prompt/cache isolation (T-008/T-041), attestation/authorization (T-052–T-054), token lifecycle or billing. This is a coverage-limited integration result, not clearance of the omitted flow or dismissal of the EOF concern.
